summary: This bill extends the period until 2037 during which the Secretary of the Interior must collect a fee for each new oil and gas drilling permit application and directs all collected fees to the BLM Permit Processing Improvement Fund for fiscal years 2027 through 2037.

scores.thoughts: This bill extends the period for collecting fees for new permits to drill and directs these fees to the BLM Permit Processing Improvement Fund. This mechanism generates revenue for a specific government fund, which can be seen as increasing government resources for permit processing, thus slightly increasing government spending capacity in that area.

The bill extends the period for collecting fees for oil and gas drilling permits and directs these fees to improve permit processing. By streamlining and extending the ability to issue drilling permits, it facilitates more oil and gas extraction, which generally leads to increased fossil fuel use and associated environmental impacts, thus pushing towards less environmental regulation in practice.
